description: Norther Province Provincial Council - Local Authorities (Standard by - Laws) Act No. 6 of 1952 Approved Standard by Laws for Local Authorities in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the approval and publication of Standard By-Laws for Local Authorities in the Northern Province under the Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) Act, No. 6 of 1952. It involves the creation of regulatory frameworks and legal instruments (by-laws) for municipal governance, which falls under the definition of Legal/Regulatory matters. While a government official (C. V. Wigneswaran) is named, the core content is about establishing legal regulations rather than detailing his specific portfolio responsibilities or being primarily about a personnel appointment.
